 Joe Rindl, Charlotte Coates, Emma Smith & Gary Rose
 Most recent Most popular Post published at 33 mins 33 mins 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 Fulham have matched Manchester City so far. There really isn't much between the two sides.
 0 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Maresca fuming published at 13:02 GMT 13:02 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 Shamoon Hafez 
Football reporter at Etihad Stadium 
 Enzo Maresca is not a happy man on that touchline.
 He spins around, struts angrily in the technical area before throwing his arms up in the air.
 That wouldn't have looked out of place on a catwalk in Milan fashion week.
 28 14 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Berge isn't giving Foden any peace' published at 13:02 GMT 13:02 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 Joe Cole 
Former Chelsea and England midfielder on TNT Sports 
 Phil Foden has got his arms in there. I want Foden to be freed up, let him come deep and get on the ball.
 Let him build himself into the game. Sander Berge is not giving him a minutes peace. 
 18 6 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 31 mins 31 mins 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 Once again Fulham look sharp on the counter as Oscar Bobbs gets on the ball in the box but he can't find a team-mate in the middle. 
 The flag then goes up just as Sander Berge has an effort palmed behind by the diving Gianluigi Donnarumma.
 9 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 13:00 GMT 13:00 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 Leno had no control as Haaland kicks it out of his hands!
 Phil, Durham 
 196 267 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 29 mins 29 mins 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 There might be a suggestion that Leno briefly let go of the ball right as Haaland kicked it. It's so close.
 102 88 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Can't be a foul' published at 12:58 GMT 12:58 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 Rachel Corsie 
Former Scotland defender on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 That can't be a foul. I'm shocked it was given as one on the field.
 When you see it back that is no foul, definitely not.
 261 353 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Haaland was well in his right to have a go' published at 12:58 GMT 12:58 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 Joe Cole 
Former Chelsea and England midfielder on TNT Sports 
 It's one of them, it's letter of the law against how do you feel in the situation. 
 Bernd Leno had no control of it and Erling Haaland was well within his right to go in and have a go. 
 210 235 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 12:57 GMT 12:57 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 Michael Brown 
Former Manchester City and Fulham midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 How soft is that? I don't think Bernd Leno has got enough control on that.
 250 302 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'It's very harsh' published at 12:57 GMT 12:57 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 Joe Cole 
Former Chelsea and England midfielder on TNT Sports 
 Image source, Getty Images Bernd Leno does get two hands on it. Erling Haaland doesn't get much contact which is unusual for him. It's very harsh.
 Leno's got no control of the ball because he can't read Haaland hitting the ball. 
 215 305 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 DISALLOWED GOAL published at 26 mins 26 mins 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 Image source, Getty Images Boos from the City supporters. VAR rules it out.
 We have a HUGE talking point.
 1351 409 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 GOAL - Man City 1-1 Fulham published at 12:54 GMT 12:54 GMT 
 Erling Haaland (24 mins) 
 It's a goal. But this is going to be very controversial!
 Manchester City think they're level as Ndiaye's cross finds Haaland whose shot is saved.
 Then on the rebound does Haaland kick the ball out of keeper Bernd Leno's hand? The ball is in the net.
 349 892 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Fulham aren't scared of City' published at 12:53 GMT 12:53 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 Joe Cole 
Former Chelsea and England midfielder on TNT Sports 
 Fulham have bodies in the box. They're coming here with no fear of this Man City team. 
 They're attacking with four or five players at a time. 
 278 62 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 22 mins 22 mins 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 Fulham hunt a second. Josh King's cross is easily gathered by Donnarumma and then Calvin Bassey has to bring down Phil Foden to stop a counter.
 Yellow card.
 95 53 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 12:51 GMT 12:51 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 If only Maresca could organise his defence as well as his outfits…
 Nick, Kent 
 357 53 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 21 mins 21 mins 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 The game's changed now. It's all Manchester City. Iliman Ndaiye crosses for Erling Haaland but his header back across goal is cleared.
 78 76 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Donnarumma had no chance' published at 12:49 GMT 12:49 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 Joe Cole 
Former Chelsea and England midfielder on TNT Sports 
 What a finish, Rodrigo Muniz stuck that away lovely. 
 City have to deal with that. It comes to Oscar Bobb, a lovely weight on the pass. Bobb is playing with Ruben Dias and Elliott Anderson there. 
 Goalkeeper Donnarumma had no chance, he was blindsided. 
 249 56 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 12:49 GMT 12:49 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 Manchester City could be about to lose four in a row. 
 376 97 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Great finish from Fulham' published at 12:48 GMT 12:48 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 Michael Brown 
Former Man City and Fulham midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Really well worked down that right hand side.
 Rodrigo Muniz takes a touch and just curls it with his right foot.
 Brilliant counter attack and a great finish from Fulham.
 257 49 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Hosts stunned published at 12:47 GMT 12:47 GMT 
 Man City 0-1 Fulham 
 Shamoon Hafez 
Football reporter at Etihad Stadium 
 That a brilliant finish from Rodrigo Muniz and Manchester City boss Enzo Maresca turns away in disgust.
 City are behind again and have work to do to turn this around.
 The home fans are stunned.
